subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
6.  
The shares of Ritik Ltd. are presently traded at ` 64 and the company is expected to 
pay dividends of ` 6 per share with a growth rate expected at 12% per annum. It plans 
to raise fresh equity share capital. The merchant banker has suggested that an 
underpricing of ` 3 is necessary in pricing the new issue besides involving a cost of ` 1 
per share on miscellaneous expenses. The cost of new equity shares (assuming no 
change in dividend rate and growth rate) will be:  
(A)  
18%  
(B)  
17.5%  
(C)  
20.25%  
(D)  
22% 
 (2 Marks)
suggested_answer: (D) 22% Ke = D1 g NP + Net proceeds per share = P0 - underpricing – Floatation cost = 64 - 3 – 1 = 60 Ke = 6 + 0.12 60 = 22%
